Every C and C2 fact cites exactly one physical manual page from the selected range; nothing relies on outside knowledge.
The night stopping table states deceleration in feet per second rather than an acceleration unit; that line is not taught, and only the speed, reaction, braking and stopping columns are used [A01].
The night table assumes low beams and a slower nighttime reaction time, so its figures differ from the daytime stopping table in the vehicle-control section; each is reported on its own page [A01].
The nationwide work zone crash counts are a federal-scale statistic quoted by the manual, kept as printed and isolated as dynamic [A04].
The water emergency page gives two different times (how long a closed car floats and how much time is enough to escape); both are kept as printed rather than merged [A07].
